# Ilana Unger — Israeli status & immigration lawyer for couples (Adv. Ilana Unger)
> Israeli lawyer (member of the Israel Bar Association) who represents couples where one partner is not Israeli: the graduated procedure (הליך מדורג / ступенчатая процедура) for married spouses, status for common-law partners (ידועים בציבור), Population and Immigration Authority (Ministry of Interior) interviews, appeals against refusals, complex status cases, and lasting powers of attorney / guardianship. Works in Hebrew, Russian and English, with clients across Israel.

## Services
- [Graduated procedure for married spouses](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/graduated-procedure-spouses/): Guidance through Israel’s graduated procedure for the foreign spouse of an Israeli citizen: application, documents, Ministry of Interior interview, renewals and citizenship. (Hebrew: [הליך מדורג לבני זוג נשואים](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/hlich-medurag-nesuim/); Russian: [Ступенчатая процедура для супругов](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/stupenchataya-procedura/))
- [Status for common-law partners](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/common-law-partners-status/): Israeli status for the foreign partner of an Israeli without registered marriage (common-law, including same-sex couples): evidence, documents, interview and guidance. (Hebrew: [מעמד לידועים בציבור](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/yeduim-batzibur/); Russian: [Статус для пар без брака](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/grazhdanskij-brak-status/))
- [Ministry of Interior interview preparation](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/interview-preparation/): Preparation for the Population Authority interview on the genuineness of your relationship: what is asked, how to prepare, what to bring and what happens next. (Hebrew: [הכנה לראיון במשרד הפנים](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/hachana-leraayon/); Russian: [Подготовка к собеседованию в МВД](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/sobesedovanie-mvd/))
- [Appealing a Ministry of Interior refusal](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/appeal-refusal/): Received a Population Authority refusal on a status application? Review of the reasons, objection, appeal to the Appeals Tribunal and key deadlines. Contact me early. (Hebrew: [ערר על סירוב משרד הפנים](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/arar-al-siruv/); Russian: [Обжалование отказа МВД](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/obzhalovanie-otkaza-mvd/))
- [Complex status cases](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/complex-cases/): An interrupted procedure, a past criminal record, staying without a visa, separation or a partner’s death, the humanitarian committee — careful review of complex status cases in Israel. (Hebrew: [מקרים מורכבים של מעמד](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/mikrim-murkavim/); Russian: [Сложные случаи со статусом](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/slozhnye-sluchai/))
- [Lasting power of attorney & guardianship](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/en/lasting-power-of-attorney/): Lasting power of attorney (ייפוי כוח מתמשך) and guardianship in Israel: protect yourself and your family in advance — property, health and personal matters. (Hebrew: [ייפוי כוח מתמשך ואפוטרופסות](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/yipui-koach-mitmashech/); Russian: [Долгосрочная доверенность и опекунство](https://ilanaungerlaw.com/ru/doverennost-opeka/))

## Frequently asked questions
- **How long does the graduated procedure take?** Usually several years: status is granted in stages and renewed. Exact timing depends on your case — we’ll go over it in the consultation.
- **Do we have to be married?** No. Common-law partners can go through the procedure too, but they need to prove a shared life.
- **The Ministry refused. What now?** A refusal can be appealed. Don’t wait — appeals have deadlines. Send me the decision and I’ll tell you your options.
- **What is the interview like?** Partners are usually interviewed separately about their life together. Preparation helps you answer calmly and accurately.
- **How much does a consultation cost?** The first consultation is free. After that, the fee depends on the complexity of the case — I’ll tell you in advance.
- **Can we talk in Russian or English?** Yes. I work in Hebrew, Russian and English.
